sn14.11:1.4: Ābhādhātu subhadhātu ākāsānañcāyatanadhātu viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu || ||
sn14.11:2.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn14.11:2.2: Yā cāyam bhante ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākāsānañcāyatanādhātu yā ca viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu yā ca nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu || || Imā nu kho bhante dhātuyo kim paṭicca paññāyantīti || || 4
sn14.11:3.1: Yāyam bhikkhu ābhādhātu ayaṃ dhātu andhakāram paṭicca paññāyati || || 5
sn14.11:3.2: Yāyam bhikkhu subhadhātu ayaṃ dhātu asubham paṭicca paññāyati || 6
sn14.11:3.3: Yāyam bhikkhu ākāsānañcāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu rūpam paṭicca paññāyati || || 7
sn14.11:3.4: Yāyam bhikkhu viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ paṭicca paññāyati || || 8
sn14.11:3.5: Yāyam bhikkhu ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu viññāṇañcāyatanam paṭicca paññāyati || 9
sn14.11:3.6: Yāyam bhikkhu nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu ākiñcaññāyatanam paṭicca paññāyati || 10
sn14.11:3.7: Yāyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu ayaṃ dhātu nirodhaṃ paṭicca paññāyatīti || || 11
sn14.11:4.1: Yā cāyam bhante ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākāsānañcāyatana dhātu yā ca viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu yā ca nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu || imā nu kho bhante dhātuyo kathaṃ samāpatti pattabbāti || || 12
sn14.11:5.1: Yā cāyam bhikkhu ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākāsanañcāyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇāñcāyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu || imā dhātuyo saññāsamāpatti pattabbā || || 13
sn14.11:5.2: Yāyam bhikkhu nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu saṅkhārāvasesasamāpatti pattabbā || || 14
sn14.11:5.3: Yāyam bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu ayam dhātu nirodhasamāpatti pattabbā ti || ||
